title: Tire hotel
description: Seasonal tire storage for your customers

list.search: Search by plate, customer, brand or shelf
list.empty: No tire sets yet. Check in a set to get started.
list.emptyNoShelves: No shelves yet. Set up your storage layout before checking tires in.

checkIn.title: Check in tires
checkIn.description: Record what arrived, then choose where it goes.
checkIn.quantityHint: Counted individually, so a pair or a five-wheel set works too.
checkIn.dotHint: Week and year the tire was made.
checkIn.pickLocationFirst: Choose a shelf before checking the set in
checkIn.roomSummary: {locations} shelves fit this set, {tires} tire slots free
checkIn.nothingFits: No shelf has room for {quantity} tires. Free up space or add another shelf.
checkIn.treadHint: Optional, but it settles any dispute about condition later.
checkIn.failed: Could not check the set in
checkIn.noVehiclesForCustomer: This customer has no vehicles yet. Add one from their customer page first.
checkIn.treatmentsHint: What should be done to this set before it is stored or refitted.
checkIn.storedBeforeHint: Bringing the same tires back? Pick the set so this season joins its history.

storage.title: Shelves
storage.description: Set up your storage once, then see at a glance what fits where.
storage.deleteWarehouseBody: This removes the location and all its shelves.
storage.deleteWarehouseBodyOccupied: This location still holds {count} tires, so it will be archived rather than deleted.
storage.noLocations: No shelves yet. Add a rack to start storing tires here.
storage.emptyBody: Add your first building or room, then fill it with shelves.
storage.codeHint: Written on the label. Filled in for you if you leave it blank.
storage.capacityHint: How many individual tires fit here.
storage.bulkCreatedWithSkips: Created {created} shelves, skipped {skipped} that already existed
storage.deleteLocationBody: The shelf has to be empty first.

detail.deleteBody: The set and its full history are removed. This cannot be undone.
detail.belowLimit: {count} tire(s) at or below your replacement limit.
detail.belowLimitHint: Worth offering the customer a price while the tires are still here.
detail.disposeBody: The record and its history stay, and the shelf is freed. It stops being offered as the same tires next season.
detail.disposeFailed: Could not write the set off

checkOut.title: Check out tires
checkOut.descriptionNoLocation: Returning this set to the customer.
checkOut.treadTitle: Tread depth on the way out
checkOut.failed: Could not check the set out

conditionLead.replace: One or more tires are at or below your replacement limit. Worth telling the customer before they drive off.
conditionLead.fair: One or more tires are close to your replacement limit. Worth a word before next season.

checkOut.treadHintUnmeasured: No reading was taken when these came in. This is the last chance to record one.

relocate.title: Move tires
relocate.description: Pick the shelf this set moves to.

edit.title: Edit tire set
edit.description: Correct what was recorded at check-in. Use Move to change the shelf.
edit.quantityHint: Raising this is checked against the shelf the set sits on.

agreement.title: Storage billing
agreement.description: What the customer pays to keep this set on the shelf.
agreement.none: No agreement yet. Add one to start billing for this set.
agreement.endDateHint: Leave blank to keep it open-ended.
agreement.autoRenewHint: Keeps billing into the next period until someone ends the agreement.
agreement.extrasHint: Priced alongside storage: washing, balancing, a TPMS reset.
agreement.waiveBody: The customer will not be billed for it. The period stays in the history.
agreement.endBody: Billing stops. Invoices already raised are untouched.
agreement.endBodyPending: Billing stops and {count} unbilled period(s) will be waived. Invoices already raised are untouched.
agreement.addToOpen: Or add to an open job
agreement.noOpenInvoices: No open jobs for this customer.
agreement.newWorkOrderHint: Attached to the vehicle, so it reaches the board.
agreement.deleteBody: Nothing was invoiced under it, so the agreement and its unbilled periods are removed. This cannot be undone.
agreement.chargeBody: A single fee for this set. Nothing renews and nothing raises the next one.

treatments.title: Prep work
treatments.none: Nothing to do on this set.
treatments.pickHint: Tick what this set needs before it goes back on the car.

messaging.title: Message the customer
messaging.noCustomerBody: Link a customer to the set before messaging them.
messaging.subject: Subject
messaging.smsLong: Long messages may be split into several texts.

bodies.low_tread: Hi {customer_name}, your {season} tires are stored with us at {shop_name}. When we checked them in, the {positions} measured {tread}, which is under the limit. They won't get through another season. Want a price on a new set?
bodies.damage: Hi {customer_name}, your {season} tires are stored with us at {shop_name}. We found damage on the {positions} when we checked them in. Give us a call when you get a chance and we'll go through it with you.
bodies.stored: Hi {customer_name}, your {season} tires are now in storage with us at {shop_name}. We'll let you know when it's time to swap them back.
bodies.custom: Hi {customer_name}, about your {season} tires stored with us at {shop_name}:

messaging.enableInSettings: Not set up yet. Turn it on in Settings.

job.none: Nothing raised for this set yet.
job.noMatch: Nothing in stock matches {size}. The line is added at the price you set.
job.noSize: This set has no size recorded, so stock cannot be matched. The line is added at the price you set.
job.needsVehicle: Link a vehicle to this set before booking a job.
job.notOnShelf: This set is no longer in storage.
job.targetNewHint: Raise a job just for these tires.
job.targetExisting: Or add to a job already open for this vehicle
job.unlinkTitle: Unlink these tires from the job?
job.unlinkBody: The job stops pointing at the tire set. The parts and labour lines already on it stay, so remove them separately if they should not be billed.
job.searchStock: Search inventory by brand, size or part number
job.noStockItem: No stock item, priced by hand

label.title: Print tire labels
label.description: Stickers for each tire, with a QR that opens this set.
label.shelfNote: The shelf is not printed on purpose. Sets get moved, and a printed shelf would then be wrong. Scanning the QR always shows where it is now.
label.previewScale: Shown at print size. Scanning the code on screen works too.

wear.seasonsLeft: {count, plural, =0 {At the limit now} one {Roughly one more season} other {Roughly # more seasons}}

forecast.title: Next season
forecast.subtitle: What your stored sets are measured to need, by size.
forecast.empty: Nothing is measured close to its limit yet. Sets need two visits before a rate can be worked out.
forecast.nowCount: {count, plural, one {# set at the limit} other {# sets at the limit}}
forecast.nextCount: {count, plural, one {# set within a season} other {# sets within a season}}
forecast.caveat: Sets already at the limit are measured. The rest is extrapolated from one customer’s wear over one interval, so treat it as demand to plan around, not an order to place.
forecast.unmeasured: {count, plural, one {# set has too little history to judge and is not counted} other {# sets have too little history to judge and are not counted}}
